agentProfile.agentPrompt: Customer returns (Return Material Receipt): goods a customer sends back against a completed goods shipment, optionally refunded with a factura rectificativa (corrective sales invoice). Entity `returnMaterialReceipt` is the header, `returnMaterialReceiptLine` the lines. Two ways to create one. FAST PATH, from one shipment: etendo_action `createReturn` on the completed goods shipment (spec goods-shipment, entity goodsShipment) creates the return already linked to it, in DRAFT; omit `lines` to return everything still returnable, or send {lines:[{lineId, returnQuantity}]} to return exactly those (the answer lists each created line with its sourceLineId). THE UI's FLOW, which also lets one return take lines from several shipments of the same customer, in this order: (1) create the header with etendo_create on `returnMaterialReceipt`: businessPartner and partnerAddress are the fields to send — warehouse, movementDate, document type and currency are defaulted — and etendo_schema with view:"create" (or etendo_defaults) is the authority on what a create needs; (2) etendo_action `availableShipments` with {businessPartner} and id "_" lists the customer's completed shipments that still have quantity to return; (3) `availableShipmentLines` with {shipmentId} and id "_" lists that shipment's returnable lines; (4) `importShipmentLines` on the new header id with {lines:[{sourceLineId, returnQuantity}]} adds the return lines; (5) confirm the return with the DocAction button (action documentAction, docAction CO) — confirming does NOT create the factura rectificativa, the corrective invoice that refunds the return; that is a SEPARATE call made after the confirmation; (6) `rectifiableInvoices` on the header id lists the invoices it can rectify and hasReturnInvoice (true when the return already has a factura rectificativa); (7) `createReturnInvoice` on the header id with {originInvoices:[...]} (optional: by default the invoice the returned shipment lines were billed on) creates the factura rectificativa, links it to the invoices it rectifies and confirms it, leaving it COMPLETED. It does NOT refuse a second call: a return that already has one gets another, so check hasReturnInvoice first; the answer lists the ones it had before in previousReturnInvoices. It answers {id, documentNo, documentStatus, documentType, isSalesTransaction, grandTotalAmount, totalLines (net), linkedReturnId, returnDocumentNo, rectifiedInvoices, previousReturnInvoices}; the amounts are negative because it refunds. A product with no price to refund answers 422 returnInvoiceWithoutAmount (naming the products) and creates nothing; a return whose shipment was never invoiced answers 400 (no invoice to rectify). The classic invoice buttons of the window (GenerateTo, Invoicefromshipment) are not agent paths: they point at createReturnInvoice. Return lines exist only by import: there is no manual line entry with a product. A return can never take more than what is still returnable of a shipment line: what other non-voided returns of that line hold, drafts included, is already taken. Asking for more answers 422 returnQuantityExceedsAvailable (naming the product, the requested and the available quantity) and creates nothing, including when the quantity of an existing return line is edited above it. etendo_schema with view:"actions" returns each action's parameters.
